## Why This Is Asked

- Cost control via budgets and cost management

```hcl
resource "azurerm_cosmosdb_account" "example" {
  name                = "example-cosmosdb"
  location            = "EUROPE"
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.example.name
  offer_type          = "Standard"
  kind                = "GlobalDocumentDB"
  capabilities        = ["EnableMultipleWriteLocations"]
  geo_location {
    location  = "France Central"
```

## Why This Is Asked

Evaluates expertise in designing enterprise-grade observability solutions across multi-tenant Azure environments, emphasizing security, governance, and infrastructure-as-code practices.

## Key Concepts

- Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights for cross-tenant data aggregation
- Private Link for secure data ingress across tenant boundaries
- Azure Lighthouse for centralized cross-tenant access management
- Azure Policy for automated tagging enforcement and governance
- Terraform with GitHub Actions for infrastructure-as-code deployment
- Budget alerts and cost control mechanisms

## Code Example

```yaml
# GitHub Actions workflow for Terraform CI/CD
name: Observability-IaC-Pipeline
on:
  push:
    paths: ['terraform/**']
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 9 * * *'  # Daily budget check

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Terraform Format Check
        run: terraform fmt -check
      - name: Terraform Validate
```
